description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 27.11.2023 to 03.12.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the determination of customs exchange rates by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving the implementation of statutory powers (Section 17 of Chapter 235) and establishes legally binding rates for customs duties and charges, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
